name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Canalsat
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sends a CanalSat infrared remote code to a remote transmitter.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The address (or sub-device) to send to, see dumper output for more details. Defaults to `0`.

config_entries.label: Device
config_entries.description: The device to send to, see dumper output for more details.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
